trigger: authenticated profile read returns no taxonomy values
visible_contract: Show optional profile questions with no inferred defaults; show India only when the configured country allowlist is explicitly selected
recovery: Return to home or remain on form
accessibility: Heading; fieldset/legend; labels; keyboard focus; 44px target intent
privacy_boundary: No country/IP/provider inference; fields are optional

trigger: authenticated profile read returns saved taxonomy values
visible_contract: Show canonical values and an explicit edit affordance; do not show a recommendation or score
accessibility: Programmatic value/name; focus returns to edit control

visible_contract: Show dirty state and exact current input; contact fields remain optional and independent
canonical_data: No canonical write until explicit save
recovery: Keep in-memory input; offer user-initiated copy/download per local draft contract
accessibility: Input purpose; autocomplete/inputmode; errors associated with field
privacy_boundary: No provider lookup or WhatsApp claim

visible_contract: Disable duplicate save; announce saving without claiming success
accessibility: Live status; focus remains stable; no auto-navigation
privacy_boundary: No raw phone/education values in logs or analytics

visible_contract: Show saved status, revision, and next action; confirm this did not change access
canonical_data: Server canonical snapshot; local recovery removed after successful cleanup
recovery: Retry local cleanup if cleanup cannot be verified
accessibility: Status text and icon, not colour only; focus to status/action
privacy_boundary: Deletion/retention follows security policy; no channel opt-in implied

visible_contract: Explain that no profile taxonomy was saved and can be added later
accessibility: Announce skip result; preserve route intent
privacy_boundary: Skip does not affect authorization, access, or score

visible_contract: Show offline state and preserved in-memory input; no synced/saved claim
canonical_data: No canonical write; browser-local recovery only if allowed by local-draft policy
recovery: Copy/download a user-requested recovery copy; retry online
privacy_boundary: Auto-recovery must purge per seven-day/sign-out policy; contact fields are not auto-persisted until separately approved

visible_contract: Name the failed save, preserve input, and provide trace-safe retry
canonical_data: No success claim; canonical revision unchanged
recovery: Retry same idempotency intent or use recovery copy
accessibility: Alert associated with fields/actions; focus to error
privacy_boundary: Do not expose provider/database details or raw values

visible_contract: Explain that a newer profile exists; show reload path without overwriting either copy
canonical_data: Canonical server state wins until explicit user choice
recovery: Compare server and local; resubmit against latest revision
accessibility: Focus to conflict summary; both choices keyboard reachable

trigger: invalid canonical value or missing conditional other text
visible_contract: Associate a plain-language error with the exact field; do not coerce silently
recovery: Keep safe input in editor; retry after correction
accessibility: Inline error plus summary; screen-reader association; visible focus
privacy_boundary: Do not echo full phone values in error telemetry

visible_contract: Explain session expiry and reassure that unsaved work is not falsely marked saved
recovery: Resume intended onboarding route after re-authentication
accessibility: Focus to recovery action; no lost-route loop
privacy_boundary: Local recovery is device-scoped and purged under sign-out policy

trigger: taxonomy reference artifact unavailable at build/runtime
visible_contract: Keep free-text degree/specialization and skip paths available; do not show a false complete list
recovery: Support/release owner repairs source artifact; end user is not asked to fetch official files"
accessibility: Fallback controls retain labels and keyboard order
privacy_boundary: No end-user source fetch or external data transfer

visible_contract: Show profile summary and separate phone/WhatsApp rows; show no verification or channel status
accessibility: Heading hierarchy; row labels; focus return after edit
privacy_boundary: Settings must not turn a number into messaging consent

visible_contract: Show structural skeleton without false empty values
accessibility: Announce loading where needed; no focus trap

visible_contract: Name the failed read and preserve route; do not render stale sensitive contact values as current
recovery: Retry or sign in again if unauthorized
accessibility: Alert and retry are keyboard reachable
privacy_boundary: No account existence/provider details in error

visible_contract: Authenticate first and return only to allowlisted onboarding intent
recovery: Return to safe onboarding route after auth
accessibility: Safe return route; no open redirect
privacy_boundary: No profile data in query parameters
